subject: Next steps & MAP draft: NimbleHealth POC lanes
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Wells <ewells@nimblehealth.com>, Carla Ruiz <carla.ruiz@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-09T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed MAP lanes

Hi Ethan / Carla —

Thanks for the 30-min demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) structure to keep everyone aligned. Notes below are intentionally concise so we can iterate quickly.

Call highlights
- Primary use case: embedding search + routing for clinical content (fast retrieval, patient privacy).
- Success metric for POC: 95% precision on top-3 relevant docs for clinician queries, <200ms median latency at expected concurrency (10 concurrent users).
- Risk blockers: data residency & encryption, procurement timeline (legal + SOW), security questionnaire.

Stakeholder map (as we heard)
- Economic buyer: Ethan Wells (Clinical Ops) — final budget sign-off.
- Security/IP: IT Security Team (we need point-of-contact for technical evidence).
- Procurement / Legal: Sylvia Park — will own SOW and PO.
- Day-to-day POC lead: Carla (trial coordination).

Proposed MAP lanes (short version)
1) Security review — evidence handoff, questionnaire, targeted call with your security SME (target: 10 business days)
2) Procurement/Legal — SOW and terms, initial redlines (target: 12 business days after sec sign-off)
3) Technical POC — data prep, integration, evaluation (target: 4 weeks of active testing)
4) Exec sign-off — demo outcomes, SLA/pricing decision (final cadence)

Next steps (asks)
- Carla / Sylvia: please confirm the security contact and whether you use an internal questionnaire template or prefer ours (attached is Redwood's standard security summary).
- Ethan: confirm budget window / preferred approval date range so we can align timelines.
- Rishi / Monica: internal owners — Rishi will lead security evidence; Monica will coordinate SOW prep and pricing.

Attachment: Redwood_security_summary_v1.pdf (stub) — high level, will follow full questionnaire if you prefer.

I captured this in a short MAP draft; I can push a more formal spreadsheet if folks want one. Happy to jump on a 30-min alignment call tomorrow or Thursday.

Thanks,
Mina

Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Thanks, Mina — very helpful summary. Quick clarifications:

- Security contact: forwarding to our IT Security mailbox and copying our security SME, Rajesh Kumar (raj.kumar@nimblehealth.com). Rajesh will own the questionnaire.
- Procurement: Sylvia is our procurement lead and will start a PO template once we have a preliminary SOW.
- Budget: Ethan confirms the budget window is within Q4 2027 approval (but needs final ask by 2027-11-15).

We attached our internal security questionnaire for reference (Nimble_Security_Q_v1.xlsx). Please review and let us know if Redwood can provide the standard artifacts listed in sections 2–5 (SOC2 attestation, encryption at rest details, KMS/HSM details).

Re: MAP lanes — good structure. Can you add an explicit evidence delivery column (owner + ETA) and a milestone for a short security deep-dive call? Also want a column for acceptance criteria for the POC (e.g., sample queries, latency threshold).

We are available for a 30-min security deep-dive on Wed 10/13 at 11:00 PT if that works for your team.

Carla Ruiz
Senior Program Manager, Clinical Integrations
NimbleHealth

Date: 2027-10-10T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo recap + proposed MAP lanes (internal)

Mina / Monica — forwarding Carla's note. Quick internal plan and owner assignments so we move fast: 

1) Security evidence pack (owner: Rishi) — compile SOC2 summary, encryption at rest/in-transit details, KMS flow, network diagrams, and a short implementation note on how Redwood isolates customer data for POCs. Target deliverable: email + link to GDrive folder within 3 business days.
2) MAP spreadsheet (owner: Mina) — include lanes Carla requested (evidence owner + ETA, acceptance criteria). Target: first draft by EOD 10/11.
3) Pricing / SOW stub (owner: Monica) — draft SOW skeleton with POC scope and terms so Sylvia has something to redline. Target: 10/14.
4) Security deep-dive scheduling (owner: Mina + Rishi) — confirm Wed 10/13 11:00 PT with Rajesh.

Also: Monica, can you pre-draft a short one-pager on trial billing and overage expectations to put into the MAP?

I'll pick up the SOC2 attestation artifact and a short risk note.

-Rishi

Rishi Malhotra
Manager, Solutions Security | Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Attached is the first MAP draft (MAP_Nimble_20271009.xlsx) per the asks. Inline summary below so it’s easy to scan. I included explicit acceptance criteria for the POC and an evidence column with owners and ETAs.

MAP summary (high level)
- Security lane
  - Deliverable: Completed security questionnaire + SOC2 attestation copy
  - Owner: Rishi Malhotra (Redwood) / Rajesh Kumar (Nimble security)
  - ETA: 2027-10-15 (questionnaire) / 2027-10-14 (SOC2 link)

- Procurement & Legal lane
  - Deliverable: SOW skeleton + initial redlines
  - Owner: Monica Patel (Redwood) / Sylvia Park (Nimble procurement)
  - ETA: 2027-10-20 (initial SOW)

- Technical POC lane
  - Deliverable: Data ingestion, test harness, runbook, evaluation report
  - Owner: Carla Ruiz (Nimble) / Mina Haddad (Redwood SE)
  - Acceptance criteria: 95% precision @ top-3, median latency <200ms at 10 concurrent users
  - ETA: POC active window 2027-10-24 to 2027-11-20
- Exec sign-off
  - Deliverable: Demo + decision memo (pricing + SLA recs)
  - Owner: Ethan Wells (Nimble) / Redwood executive sponsor (TBD)
  - ETA: target decision week starting 2027-11-15

Action items (short)
- Rishi: upload evidence pack to shared drive by 10/14 and post link.
- Monica: share SOW skeleton by 10/14.
- Carla: confirm data export cadence and permission for a short sample dataset by 10/18.
- Ethan: confirm final approval week (target 11/15) or advise if earlier.

Scheduling: confirmed security deep-dive Wed 2027-10-13 11:00 PT (calendar invite to follow).

Attachments: MAP_Nimble_20271009.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

If there are no objections, I’ll convert this into a shared Google Sheet after the security call and maintain versioning.

Best,
Mina
